title: MV Question about Galv's RPG Maker MV version of Message Bust

posts.author: elang_S
posts.body: I've been eyeing on this plugin for a good while, and it's absolutely promising but I do want to know if this plugin in particular can handle more than 2 character busts, like say one scene has 4 people arguing and whether or not having the bust in middle of the screen is possible or not

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body: From the looks of it it let's you select one image that replaces the face graphic, so probably not. However, how are you eyeing a free plugin, for a while at that, then coming here to make a thread, instead of spending 5 minutes to download said free plugin and just check for yourself?

posts.author: elang_S
posts.body:
I've tried the plugin and it indeed can only do two at a time, so I thought that it wouldn't hurt if I asked someone who's more familiar with this plugin if whether or not I can do other stuff with this
I didn't know it's actually not proper, apologies....

It's not about being proper or anything, it just didn't read like you did, which seems silly to me. As far as I can tell, you could just have all the desired actors as one image, that may work, but there are other bust plugins that can achieve this.
Visual Novel Busts plugin for RPG Maker MV by Irina
Adds visual novel style bust control for RPG Maker MV events.
atelieririna.itch.io
I only know of this paid one personally.
